# Requests redirect history self-reference

Upstream issue: https://github.com/psf/requests/issues/6295
Upstream bugfix: https://github.com/psf/requests/pull/7328
Upstream failing release tag: v2.33.1, commit 111d2b77790bf49943c0dfa09b365371c24aec7e.

The package source under src/requests is an exact copy of the upstream release-package entries fetched by blob from this tag. This is an extracted package snapshot with an added offline reproducer, not a full upstream checkout. Preserve the Apache-2.0 LICENSE.

The issue: after redirects, a Response in the final response's history may contain itself in its own history list, creating a cycle. Make redirect histories acyclic while preserving the final response's ordered redirect history. The fixed test uses an in-memory adapter, with no external requests.
samples.source_kind: verified upstream package extraction with local reproducer; not full checkout
